sources: Stone's August 15 to 22 plan (Preseason Game 3_ HC.md): the reference lineup (Monroe, Bitonio, Brewster, Turner, Johnson back at right tackle; Jones-Drew; Nicks, Thielen, Adams; Lewis, Kelce by package; Cousins; Mincey at Edge 1 for the reference possession with Ryan Davis the closed edge; Daryl Smith the communicator; Cain snapping first), the quarterback order (Cousins, Henne, Wilson, Bray, Shaw) and the medical decisions (Jackson out; Brate out; Murphy by the independent medical process, which released him August 18 and he practiced normally); the working depth chart (career/2014/00_Team_Operations/Team/Depth_Chart/working_depth_chart.json) for the rest; the camp record through August 21 for the players added but not placed, in the order of their recorded use; the current roster for control and availability.
rule: Order within each kernel position group, first = starter, as the kernel reads it. Stone's plan sets the opening lineups through rotation.json, whose blocks lead their groups on the field; this order is a game-depth order for this preseason game only. Johnson returns to fifth among the linemen, the first-group right tackle, with Lucas sixth as the replacement right tackle from the young skill group on; Lucas's Chicago assignment ended with that game and nothing here awards him a place or changes Johnson's role. Mincey stays first among the defensive linemen as the carried Edge 1 starting point and opens the reference possession; Cain first among the snappers as the carried place and opens the operation; Branch's comparable possession and Kreiter's later block are the plan's, neither a promotion. Murphy is fourth among the backs and active after his August 18 release. Jackson and Brate are listed last in their groups and inactive. The tight-end and reserve orders list the players in the order the camp record uses them and award no place; TE3 and the reserve corner remain open.

game_day_inactives.note: Preseason dresses the whole roster. Bradfield, Clemons, Brown and Pasztor are carried on the 78-player controlled roster on unsigned tenders, are not under contract, have not reported and may not practice or play until they sign: inactive by contract status, not by a medical instruction. Jerrell Jackson: out under the August 14 instruction (lower extremity, multi-week; projected return October 9, 2014; reassessed August 21 with no change), inactive by medical instruction; roster disposition pending. Cameron Brate: out, long term, under the August 8 instruction (removed from the game; projected return January 15, 2015; reassessed August 15 with no change), inactive by medical instruction and out of the plan; roster disposition pending. Richard Murphy: independent medical hold from the August 14 game, reassessed August 15 with no change, released by the independent medical process August 18, his projected date, under the record's method; took part normally August 18 to 21 and is active, reentering the developmental rotation by the plan's condition. Lane Johnson: cleared August 14, worked August 15 to 21 in full, active and the first-group right tackle by Stone's decision. No other player is under a communicated medical instruction; August 15 to 21 communicated no injury or restriction. James Hurst is held on the undrafted board pending a medical clearance and is not a controlled player, so he cannot appear here.
